office_does: Franklin PUD's three commissioners set electric rates and policy for the county's public utility district and hire its general manager.
race_blurb: Uncontested: former Franklin PUD general manager Tim Nies is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Former Franklin PUD general manager and state audit manager; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Former Franklin PUD general manager; earlier state audit manager [S1]
Priorities: keeping the Snake River dams, reliable power at reasonable cost, local control [S1]
